|game_text=Deploy on a [[Nar Shaddaa (Virtual Block 8){{!}}Nar Shaddaa]] battleground site. If you control three Nar Shaddaa locations or just won a battle (or initiated a Force drain) here, 'steal' this Effect (relocate to your side of table). Place in Used Pile if opponent controls three Nar Shaddaa locations. [Immune to [[Alter]]]
|errata_history=This is version PC-E5 of [[Imperial Navigation Charts (Errata)|Imperial Navigation Charts]]; it is the current text. The first printing is lost, so it has no page. Other versions: [[Imperial Navigation Charts (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Imperial Navigation Charts (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), [[Imperial Navigation Charts (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3), [[Imperial Navigation Charts (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4). The image is the Players Committee card image (full card with art; no slip number).
* '''Original''' (first printing; no copy survives, so no page): the first Virtual Block 8.1 printing (official text as of 11 May 2012), whose steal was optional. No copy of it survives: the surviving sheet was re-made on 18 July 2012 with the PC-E1 errata<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), page 6, slip 33 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref>. The errata post of 13 July 2012 says the stealing “is no longer optional”; the PC website card list (PC-E3) later printed an optional wording, which may be the first text, but the sheet's own words are not known.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Imperial Navigation Charts (Errata)]]): errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 13 July 2012, effective immediately (“This errata was made so that the stealing of the Charts is no longer optional”)<ref name="forum-p739757">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 13 July 2012: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=60#p739757 p739757] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: “Deploy on a Nar Shaddaa battleground site. If you control three Nar Shaddaa locations or just won a battle (or initiated a Force drain) here, 'steal' this Effect (relocate to your side of table). Place in Used Pile if opponent controls three Nar Shaddaa locations. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' “may 'steal' (relocate” became “'steal' this Effect (relocate”: the steal happens before any 'just' responses.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Imperial Navigation Charts (Errata 2)]]): re-made Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (still headed “official text as of 11 May 2012”; PDF dated 18 July 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), page 6, slip 33 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on a Nar Shaddaa battleground site. If you control three Nar Shaddaa locations or just won a battle (or initiated a Force drain) here, 'steal' this Effect (relocate to your side of table). Place in Used Pile if opponent controls three Nar Shaddaa locations. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' nothing: word for word the PC-E1 forum text. The forum post and the sheet are two publications, so two versions (Bill, 11 November 2026). A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Imperial Navigation Charts (Errata 3)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1281_32-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Deploy on a Nar Shaddaa battleground site. If you control three Nar Shaddaa locations or just won a battle (or initiated a Force drain) here, may 'steal' (relocate to your side of table). Place in Used Pile if opponent controls three Nar Shaddaa locations. (Immune to Alter).” '''What changed:''' the steal is optional (“may 'steal' (relocate”, without “this Effect”), and the list writes “(Immune to Alter).”. A repeat of an earlier text after a different one was published is a version of its own (wiki versions ruling, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Imperial Navigation Charts (Errata 4)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (cover “official text as of 27 April 2013”; Light Side, p. 25)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=25, page 25. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=25 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on a Nar Shaddaa battleground site. If you control three Nar Shaddaa locations or just won a battle (or initiated a Force drain) here, 'steal' this Effect (relocate to your side of table). Place in Used Pile if opponent controls three Nar Shaddaa locations. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' the steal is mandatory again: word for word the PC-E1 text. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E5''' (this page): the Players Committee card image, dated 7 May 2013 on the PC image server<ref name="srv-Virtual8-Light">Players Committee card image server, directory listing of <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/</code>, every card image dated 7 May 2013: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034752/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019]. The files are byte for byte the ones still served today (research R6, 10–11 November 2026).</ref>: “Deploy on a Nar Shaddaa battleground site. If you control three Nar Shaddaa locations or just won a battle (or initiated a Force drain) here, 'steal' this Effect (relocate to your side of table). Place in Used Pile if opponent controls three Nar Shaddaa locations. [Immune to Alter]” The server date is the date of a bulk upload of the whole folder: the image may have been made earlier, but it is placed at the date it can be shown to exist (Bill, 11 November 2026). '''What changed:''' nothing: word for word the PC-E1 and PC-E4 text. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
